messages.content:
Hello everyone,
In order to ensure data integrity, we are now introducing the Data Backup and Recovery Policy, effective today, November 1, 2023. The full policy and an in-depth FAQ can be found in our People Portal.
Here are some key changes we want to bring to your attention:
Device Usage:
All employees should utilize their company-provided devices for work-related tasks. If you possess a dual personal/business device, expect a separate email with instructions on acquiring your new work-only device.
Emails and Document Management: 
Please refrain from deleting any emails or documents. Emails may be archived, and outdated documents should be labeled with [DEPRECATED] or placed in a folder with the same label.
Storage Platforms:
Our primary storage options are now Google Cloud Storage and Google Drive. By November 30, 2023, ensure the migration of any current work product stored outside of these platforms to either Google Cloud Storage or Google Drive.

Please reach out to the IT team at IT@askaiden.com if you have any questions or concerns that are not addressed in the FAQ.

Thank you for your cooperation!
